intro.title: Profile
intro.text: My design style is rooted in typography, editorial layouts and simplicity, often combined with motion to create custom websites that feel polished, modern and considered. I enjoy combining visual design with digital strategy, making sure every website not only looks great but also serves a purpose and reflects the quality and ambition behind the brand and business.

profile.profileTextMobile:
My design style is rooted in typography, editorial layouts and simplicity, often combined with motion to create custom websites that feel polished, modern and considered.

I enjoy combining visual design with digital strategy, making sure every website not only looks great but also serves a purpose and reflects the quality and ambition behind the brand and business.

approach.title: Approach
approach.text: I approach every project with the same goal, creating something that looks exceptional while also serving a clear purpose. Websites should tell a story, communicate what makes a brand different, and guide visitors toward action.

newsletter.title: Newsletter
newsletter.text: Once a month, I share insights on web design, typography, creative direction and sometimes personal stories. Written for designers who still care about the fundamentals of design.
newsletter.textSecondary: With my newsletter I want to inspire and help others to built the live they dream of by being as transparent as possible.

sections.title: Privacy Policy
sections.text: At gilhuybrecht.com, I respect your privacy and am committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains what information I collect, why I collect it, and how it is used.

sections.title: Who is responsible for your data?
sections.text:
This website is operated by:

Gil Huybrecht
Belgian sole proprietorship (eenmanszaak)
Email: hello@gilhuybrecht.com

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or your personal data, you can contact me using the email address above.

sections.title: What information I collect
sections.text:
If you choose to subscribe to my newsletter, I collect:

  • Your first name
  • Your email address

Providing this information is entirely voluntary.

sections.title: Newsletter
sections.text:
I use Mailchimp to manage and send my newsletter. By subscribing, your information is securely stored and processed by Mailchimp on my behalf.

You can unsubscribe at any time by clicking the unsubscribe link included in every email.

sections.title: Analytics
sections.text:
This website uses Google Analytics to better understand how visitors use the site. This information is collected in an aggregated manner and helps improve the website and its content.

Google Analytics may collect information such as pages visited, approximate location, browser type and device information.

sections.title: How long I keep your data
sections.text: Your newsletter information is retained until you unsubscribe or request that it be deleted.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text:
If you are located in the European Economic Area (EEA), you have the right to:

  • Request access to your personal data
  • Request correction of inaccurate information
  • Request deletion of your personal data
  • Restrict or object to certain processing
  • Request a copy of your personal data

To exercise any of these rights, please email hello@gilhuybrecht.com.

sections.title: Data Security
sections.text: Reasonable technical and organisational measures are taken to protect your personal information from unauthorised access, misuse, or disclosure.

sections.title: Third-party services
sections.text:
This website relies on the following third-party services:

  • Mailchimp (newsletter management)
  • Google Analytics (website analytics)

These providers process data in accordance with their own privacy policies.

sections.title: Contact
sections.text:
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or your personal data, please contact:

Gil Huybrecht
hello@gilhuybrecht.com
